# Cyfluence Research Center

> CRC analyzes cyber-enabled hostile influence campaigns, disinformation operations, and cognitive warfare tactics deployed by state actors including Russia, China, and Iran across digital ecosystems.

The Cyfluence Research Center (CRC) is a dedicated research organization focused on understanding and documenting hostile influence operations in the digital sphere. They publish in-depth research, weekly threat analyses, and strategic assessments on information warfare, election interference, and state-sponsored disinformation campaigns targeting democracies and critical infrastructure globally.

## Key Topics

- Hostile Influence Campaigns
- Information Warfare
- Disinformation Operations
- Cognitive Warfare
- China Strategy
- Russia-Ukraine Conflict
- State Actors
- Election Interference
- Cyber Threats
- Hybrid Warfare
- Social Media Manipulation
- Smart Cities Security
- AI-Enabled Threats
- Influence Operations

## Core Resources

- [CRC Homepage](https://www.cyfluence-research.org): Homepage for Cyfluence Research Center analyzing hostile influence in digital sphere
- [Research](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/research-section): CRC research on digital influence campaigns across Russia, Ukraine, China, and more
- [Events](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/event-section): CRC events, training, and seminars on cybersecurity and influence operations
- [CRC Glossary](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/crc-glossary): Glossary of foundational and emerging terms for cyber-enabled hostile influence

## Strategic Analysis & Case Studies

- [Cognitive Warfare: China's Three Warfares Doctrine](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/cognitive-warfare-masterclass-china-s-doctrine-for-strategic-narrative-superiority): Athena Tong's analysis of China's cognitive warfare doctrine targeting Western Pacific
- [The Attack on Luxury Brands: China Case Study](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/the-attack-on-luxury-brands-a-case-study-of-the-weaponization-of-the-online-ecosystem-by-china): Deep-dive case study of China's hostile influence campaign against Western luxury brands
- [China's Influence War on the EV Market](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/china-s-influence-war-on-the-ev-market): Analysis of China's influence operations in the electric vehicle market
- [Romanian Presidential Elections 2024 Analysis](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/the-romanian-presidential-elections-2024-analysis-of-information-operations-and-long-term-inf): Analysis of Russian influence operations in Romania's 2024 presidential elections
- [Information Warfare Analysis - Russia-Ukraine War](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/information-warfare-in-the-early-stages-of-the-russia-ukraine-war): Analysis of information warfare tactics in early Russia-Ukraine conflict stages

## Infrastructure & Emerging Threats

- [Smart Cities: Cyber Threats & Information Disorder](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/smart-cities_-future-urban-environments-at-the-crosshairs-of-cyber-threats-and-information-disorder): CRC analysis of cyber and information threats to smart city infrastructure
- [Smart Cities: Indonesia's Threat Vectors & Structural Gaps](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/crc-addendum-new-threat-vectors-legacy-constraints-structural-gaps-in-indonesia-s-smart-city-visi): CRC analysis of cyber threats and gaps in Indonesia's smart cities vision
- [X's Location Transparency and Hostile Influence Campaigns](https://www.cyfluence-research.org/post/crc-spotlight-from-rollout-to-fallout-the-impact-of-xs-location-transparency-feature): Analysis of X's location transparency feature for detecting inauthentic activity
